intro: Ops enabled: 3D Rough 1 (6 mm flat, fresh stock, depth per pass 6) and 3D Rough 1 (copy) (3 mm flat, from the remaining stock of 3D Rough 1, depth per pass 3). Waterline 3 disabled. Setup 2 holds no toolpaths (list_setups), so nothing runs there. Only clearing_strategy changes between columns (both roughs).

N5 standing spurs (operator, 2026-10-23, watching the GUI): 'as it's milling down it leaves tall spurs of material; these could snap and cause issues; prominent ones 7 min in'. The operator watched the AgentSearch column (the GUI held that project, re-simulated at 0.10 mm, when they saw the spurs). Each column has an N5 block: the GUI simulation at about 7 min and at the end, and a heightmap replay of the exported .nc (phase0/tools/spurs.py: flat end mill stamps on a 0.2 mm grid; a spur is material more than 1.5 mm tall and less than 2 mm wide; free-standing means no wide material within 2 mm). The replay ignores the part, so a corner residue against a wall counts as attached, not free.

The 7-minute move comes from phase0/tools/move_time.py (G-code feed times scaled 1.016 to the AgentSearch cut trace, max error 0.8 s over 3 000 trace points; the ContourParallel end estimate is 966 s against 973 s simulated).
The stock render colours by height (blue low, red high). It does not show deviation from the model.
